page_title: IPS 1-2 SOU | Ipswich v Southampton 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Michael Oliver's book.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Julio Enciso is replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Clarke (Ipswich) comes onto the pitch so that Leif Davis can be given a rest.
87' 1 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Paul Onuachu (Southampton) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:2.

87' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
84' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is adjudged offside.
83' Southampton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
81' It will be a substitution. Adam Lallana (Southampton) is ready to enter the pitch as Lesley Ugochukwu walks off.
81' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) replacing Welington.
80' Welington (Southampton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) is flagged for offside.
77' The game has come to an end for Jens Cajuste. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
77' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
74' A yellow card for a tackle by Jan Bednarek (Southampton). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
71' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets inside the box and tries to beat Aaron Ramsdale with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
70' It is time for a substitution. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton) is on for Albert Gronbaek.
65' Liam Delap (Ipswich) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
65' Joe Aribo (Southampton) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
64' The linesman signals that Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
62' Substitution. Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) has come on for Nathan Broadhead.
61' Jan Bednarek (Southampton) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
61' The referee blows his whistle, Southampton are awarded a corner kick.
60' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
59' James Bree (Southampton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the left post.
56' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Jack Stephens is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by William Smallbone (Southampton).
55' The game is interrupted now, Jack Stephens (Southampton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Flag up against Paul Onuachu (Southampton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' Half-time substitution. Ivan Juric decided to make a change. Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) is replaced by Jack Stephens.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' A great solo run by Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Aaron Ramsdale.
44' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
41' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Julio Enciso (Ipswich), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Welington (Southampton) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Arijanet Muric pulls off a run-of-the-mill save from a header by Paul Onuachu (Southampton) after a cross from the side.
34' Liam Delap (Ipswich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Aaron Ramsdale is alert and denies him.

31' 1 - 1 GOAL! Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 1:1.
30' That looked a certain handball by Paul Onuachu (Southampton) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
28' Paul Onuachu (Southampton) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The ball finds it way to Liam Delap (Ipswich) inside the box and his first-time shot flies just over the bar.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Joe Aribo (Southampton) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
19' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
19' Foul! Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Ipswich are awarded the free kick.
18' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
13' Albert Gronbaek (Southampton) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
12' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is penalised for a foul.
10' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
7' Ipswich fail to score from a corner as Aaron Ramsdale (Southampton) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Julio Enciso (Ipswich) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Ipswich force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Michael Oliver couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jan Bednarek (Southampton) and blew his whistle.
1' The match has just started.
Southampton will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Oliver.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
